title: Mailchimp Review (2026)
intro: Email marketing platform with CRM-oriented contact and audience tools; freemium entry for smaller lists. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Mailchimp overall score 6.8/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Freemium Free tier for eligible audiences; paid plans are contact-based — verify live Mailchimp pricing. Enterprise available.
verdict: Mailchimp: Choose Mailchimp when email marketing + audience CRM features are the primary need. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
